outputs.article:
Have you ever wondered why some break under pressure while others rise up
Why This Matters
Most people face this without understanding it. Trust the God who knows your name 
The Reality
 This is where many stay trapped.
How It Works
Teaching opens with personal vulnerability and transforms through encounter with Christ.
The Turning Point
Until something changed.
What Became Possible
 This is not theory. This is transformation.
Divine Authority
Jesus Christ is the answer.
Scripture Support
John 10:10 - I have come that they may have life abundantly
Romans 6:9 - Christ dies no more; death has no dominion
2 Corinthians 5:17 - If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation
